content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently underestimate true price movements, especially in bearish sentiment environments.", "Forecast bias is amplified when sentiment remains flat or negative despite recent auction supply events.", "Price mean-reversion is evident as forecasts lag behind true outcomes during high event frequency periods.", "Sentiment spikes correlate with forecast overshoots, particularly when bullish sentiment is sustained despite negative supply net.", "Forecast accuracy deteriorates when official event balance shows high bearish pressure and low bullish sentiment.", "Model forecasts exhibit diminishing predictive power as event frequency increases and supply net remains negative.", "True price movements often outperform forecasts during periods of high event count and low sentiment volatility.", "Forecast lags are most pronounced when sentiment remains static and supply net is consistently negative."]}
